description: Source code for user authentication API endpoints, including user registration, login, profile retrieval and update, and token refresh, implemented with FastAPI framework.

methods.name: register_user( payload: RegisterRequest = Body(..., description="Registration payload"), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Handles user registration by validating input, checking for existing email or username, hashing password, creating new user in database, and returning minimal user info.

methods.name: login_user( login_data: UserLogin = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles user login by verifying email and password, returning a mock JWT token and user info.

methods.name: get_current_user_profile( request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's profile based on trusted/user headers or parameters.

methods.name: update_current_user_profile( user_update: UserUpdate = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Updates the current user's profile with provided data.

methods.name: refresh_access_token( request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Refreshes the access token, returning a mock token and user info.
